description: This Java interface defines a custom exception type for the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for exceptions related to the Thing Search service. It contains a constant error code prefix used for error identification in the service.

classes.name: ThingSearchException
classes.description: An interface aggregating all exceptions thrown by the Search service in the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: ERROR_CODE_PREFIX
methods.description: A string constant used as the prefix for error codes thrown by the Search service.
